resources.string: Move photos and videos from your phones to one place, quickly and privately.
How will you use this phone?
Sends its photos and videos to your receiving phone.
Collects photos and videos from your other phones. Google Photos on it can back them up.
Choose one phone to receive. A phone that stays at home on a charger works best, such as an older Pixel.
Pair each sending phone with it once, by scanning a code.
New photos and videos go over every night while the phones charge, or right away with Sync now. They go straight from phone to phone, encrypted, with no account.
To change this phone\'s role later, choose Reset MediaSync in the ⋮ menu.
